metadata.title: High School Musical Comedy Cover Art

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, high-energy composition featuring a smiling teenage girl holding an acoustic guitar against a backdrop of bright red school lockers. The layout uses a heavy, layered typographic treatment in the upper left, anchored by a soft pink spotlight effect.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned on the right third, balancing the heavy text block on the left
Bright red lockers provide a repetitive geometric texture behind the subject
High-contrast color palette of red, white, and purple creates a youthful energy
The guitar neck acts as a vertical lead-in line from the bottom center
coreInvariants: Vivid red locker background with visible vents and handles
Subject wearing a red and black buffalo plaid blazer
Soft pink circular glow behind the primary title text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is medium-shot, positioned on the right side of the frame, occupying approximately 40% of the horizontal space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, multi-layered title text in the upper left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves left to the large title, then down to the secondary text strip, and finally to the guitar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the locker pattern and large graphic elements.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep purple and soft pink (title shadow and glow)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation and high value across all elements for a 'pop' aesthetic.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to red, white, purple, and black

letterConstructionRules: Heavy black outlines on all characters
Dramatic drop shadows creating a 3D effect
Slightly irregular baseline for a playful feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Dots in acronyms are square and integrated into the stroke weight
Lower text block is slightly arched or warped

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a white rectangular banner

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy display face paired with a condensed, utilitarian sans-serif for information.

preserve: The 3D stacked effect of the main title
The angled banner for the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and geometric structure for the main title.
Matches the clean, high-visibility look of the secondary text banner.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a teenage girl with long dark hair, smiling, wearing a red and black plaid blazer over a white top, holding an acoustic guitar. The background is a wall of bright red metal school lockers with visible vents and silver handles. A soft pink circular glow is positioned in the upper left area.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, two-tiered title in the upper left over the pink glow using an extra-bold sans-serif. Top tier is white with black outlines; bottom tier is purple with black outlines and a 3D drop shadow. Below this, add a white rectangular banner tilted 5 degrees, containing red condensed sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the locker background a vibrant primary red?
Does the main title have a thick black outline and 3D depth?
Is the secondary text contained within a tilted white banner?
Is the subject positioned to the right to balance the text?

mustAchieve: Bright, even studio lighting on the subject

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure the subject's face
Verify the 3D effect on the title is consistent
Check that the red of the lockers doesn't clash with the red of the blazer
Confirm the pink glow is soft and doesn't have hard edges
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject(Teen/Youth) + Background(Repetitive Institutional Texture) + Graphic(Layered 3D Typography) + Accent(Angled Informational Banner) = High-Energy Youth Media Cover Art.
